note: The agent roster. Each agent: its own config (agents/<id>/, core in config/), its own state (state/agents/<id>/, core in state/), its own keys (HL_AGENT_KEY_<ID> secrets; core uses HL_AGENT_KEY), its own pot and kill switch. The dashboard lists them in this order.

agents.name: Core
agents.desc: 12-14 names, 4h flips, Bitcoin gate. The original rules; best backtested edge, fewest trades.

agents.name: Wide
agents.desc: 31 liquid names, 4h flips, no Bitcoin gate. About 1.7x the trades, smaller edge.

agents.name: Fast
agents.desc: 31 names, 1h flips inside 4h/daily/weekly. Most trades; no edge proven in backtest. Paper experiment.

agents.name: Trend
agents.desc: Doctrine bot 2: BTC+ETH long while above the 50-day average, vol-targeted, daily. Frozen rule; judged yearly, sized as tuition.

agents.name: Carry
agents.desc: Doctrine bot 1: short perp + long spot on HYPE, PUMP, XPL, BTC, ETH, ZEC; collects funding. Paper until testnet-validated; gate = capture efficiency >= 80%.

agents.name: A01 Rotation
agents.desc: Arena · rs_rotation · bull specialist · 13 coins · backtest Sharpe 1.13, max drawdown 18% · recipe rot-e335df0b (AiFi Lab). Paper; demoted automatically if it stops matching its backtest.
